description: This file implements a development version of a logging module that outputs log messages to standard output (STDOUT). It includes functions to initialize and close the logger, as well as to log messages with different priorities, timestamped and formatted accordingly. The implementation is conditionally compiled based on a build-time flag.

methods.name: void initIcLogger()
methods.description: Initializes the logger; for STDOUT, no resources need to be allocated.

methods.name: void closeIcLogger()
methods.description: Closes the logger; for STDOUT, no resources need to be released.

methods.name: void icLogMsg(const char * file,size_t filelen,const char * func,size_t funclen,long line,const char * categoryName,logPriority priority,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified category, priority, and format, including timestamp and process ID.
